Policies.draftNotice: Unreviewed development draft. This sample content is provided for testing and is not legal advice.

metadata.title: Terms of Use
metadata.description: Development draft terms for using this application.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These dummy terms describe the expected use of this development service. By creating an account, you accept this version for testing purposes.

service.title: Using the service
service.body: Use the service only for lawful testing and in a way that does not harm other people, accounts, systems, or networks. The operator may change, suspend, or withdraw development features without notice.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Provide an email address you control, use verification links only for your own account, and protect your active session. You are responsible for activity performed through your session.

conduct.title: Acceptable conduct
conduct.body: Do not automate abusive requests, probe for other users, bypass access controls or request limits, interfere with delivery, or use the service to distribute unlawful or harmful material.

availability.title: Development availability
availability.body: The service is provided as available for development and testing. It may contain defects or lose availability, and no uninterrupted or error-free operation is promised.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: This draft may be replaced by a later version. A new signup records the version accepted at submission, and the recorded version remains associated with that activation.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Direct questions about this draft or the service to the operator responsible for this deployment.

metadata.title: Privacy Notice
metadata.description: Development draft notice describing signup data handling.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This dummy notice explains how the development service handles information used for signup and account access.

collection.title: Information collected
collection.body: The service stores the name and email you submit, account and verification state, the accepted policy versions and time, database session records, and coarse security or request-limit data.

use.title: How information is used
use.body: Information is used to create and verify your account, send account emails, establish sessions, preserve your policy acceptance, operate the service, and prevent abuse.

sharing.title: Service providers
sharing.body: Information is processed by the application hosting, database, and configured email-delivery services needed to operate the account flow. This development service does not sell personal information.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Active account and acceptance records are retained with the account. Inactive pending accounts may be retained for safe signup retries. Short-lived verification links expire, and application logs are designed to exclude names, emails, links, and session material.

security.title: Security
security.body: The service uses mailbox verification, one-time links, request limits, private database networking, and protected sessions. No development system can guarantee absolute security.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You may choose not to create an account. Direct questions or requests about stored information to the operator responsible for this deployment.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: This draft may be replaced by a later version. Signup records the notice version accepted with the onboarding link.
